app_fee.value: No application fee is stated on Sorbonne University's doctoral admission or ADUM enrolment pages; the €398 doctoral fee (plus CVEC) is the annual national enrolment fee paid after admission.

fee_waiver.value: No application-fee waiver is stated. Non-EU doctoral candidates are exempt from differentiated tuition fees and pay the €398 national enrolment rate after admission (with enrolment-fee exemptions available for eligible grant, cotutelle, or social-criteria cases).
fee_waiver.quote: Students enrolling in a doctoral programme, a third-cycle programme in health studies or an accreditation to supervise research (HDR) programme.

gre_general.value: No university-wide GRE requirement is stated on Sorbonne University's doctoral pages.

toefl_min.value: No university-wide TOEFL minimum is stated on Sorbonne University's doctoral admission or enrolment pages.

ielts_min.value: No university-wide IELTS minimum is stated on Sorbonne University's doctoral admission or enrolment pages.

english_waiver.value: No university-wide English-test exemption rule (including for Indian degrees) is stated on the doctoral pages checked; foreign Master's diplomas not in French or English require an English diploma supplement or sworn French translation.

notes: Doctoral applications are handled by individual doctoral schools and validated via ADUM once a thesis supervisor and funding (mandatory in exact/experimental sciences) are secured. Checked English and French application-and-admission pages, International Welcome Desk doctoral admission page, enrolment-procedures-and-tuition-fees (2026/27 €398 doctoral rate), inscriptions-reinscriptions-en-doctorat, and the PhD enrollment checklist PDF. 404 URL: https://www.sorbonne-universite.fr/le-doctorat/college-doctoral-et-ecoles-doctorales/les-programmes-doctoraux/programmes-doctoraux.
